title: Sensor 1 Supply Voltage Low Error
detail_of_failure: Low voltage is sensed in sensor 1 power supply circuit.
controller_action: Operates with ambient pressure as fixed value.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Startability deteriorates.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors that follow one by one, and turn the starting switch to the ON position each time. 3. When troubleshooting is done, go back to Step 1. If this code is cleared, disconnected sensor or engine wiring harness is defective. REMARK Other failure codes are shown at the same time. This occurs because the connector is disconnected. So ignore codes other than this failure code [CA352]. Connector Ambient pressure sensor AMB. AIR PRESSURE Engine wiring harness ECM
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector ECM. Connect a T-adapter to the male side. 3. Disconnect the connector ECM. Turn the starting switch to the ON position in this condition.
